description.content:
Get Products, NB: Filtering & sorting is not supported for the following fields: length, delivery_time, packaging_type, alcohol_registry_number, alcohol_percentage
batches, excise_declaration_number, tax_free, is_regular_gift_card, reward_points_not_allowed, non_stock_product, cashier_must_enter_price, labels_not_needed, deposit_fee_amount
In filteration `group_id_with_sub` with `in` operator can be used in filters to get group ids with subgroups
also `category_id_with_sub` with `in` operator can be used in filters to get category ids with subgroups

query.description: comma or semicolon separated list of fields to fetch
skip n records
items to take, default: 20, max: 100000
the sort parameter is explained in the `Filtering & Sorting` section on top of the Swagger documentation
the filter parameter is explained in the `Filtering & Sorting` section on top of the Swagger documentation
optionally return total number of records in the X-Total-Count response header

header.description: total number of records (ignores skip & take parameters)

description.content:
`useDiscardedProductRecipe` can be true only for Assembly, Bundle products if the kept product’s recipe is replaced by the discarded product’s recipe.
`useDiscardedProductVariations` can be true only for Matrix products, if the kept product’s child products are replaced by the discarded product’s child products

The back-up ID can be passed to create product, update product & update product type endpoints as well as their bulk variants.
Once passed, the system will keep a back-up of the products catalogue. To restore the catalogue, use this endpoint with the backupID.
There can be only one back-up in the system.
Return information on what would be restored with the restore products by backup ID call.
